integrity: The unbounded theorem is proved analytically; machine checks are supplemental. No independence or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only diameter-three double-star trees with leaf counts 1 and n>=3; no assertion about other branch counts or stationary laws; n=2 only provides a counterexample to this formula. An undiscovered equivalent source remains possible.
title: Unique fastest mixing on a broom tree with one elongated arm
